name: Ichijou Mamoru
source:
The protagonist of this work. A third-year high school student.
A young student who leads the Magi Knight organization in the Kamiyama City district.
Haruka Kamiyama, a Magi Knight in this district, is Mamoru’s girlfriend, and as his partner, they fight side by side as an inseparable pair.
